units.source_text: 父亲的病似乎已经到了只等最后一击的关头，在鬼门关前徘徊着。

en.t: Father's illness seemed to have reached the point where it was only waiting for the final blow, lingering at the gates of death.

units.source_text: 全家人每天晚上都担着心上床，不知这命运的裁决会不会是今天。

en.t: Every night the whole family went to bed anxious, not knowing whether the verdict of fate would come that very day.

units.source_text: 看父亲的样子已经感觉不到任何痛苦了，这样一来，护理反倒变得轻松起来。

en.t: From the way Father looked, he no longer seemed to feel any pain, and because of that the nursing actually became easier.

units.source_text: 为了以防万一，只留下一个人守在病人房间里，其他人可以轮流着回到自己的床铺上休息。

en.t: As a precaution, we left only one person watching in the sickroom, while the others could take turns returning to their own beds to rest.

units.source_text: 一天夜里，我心里想事，还没睡着的时候，恍惚听见病人的呻吟声，

en.t: One night, while I was thinking about things and had not yet fallen asleep, I vaguely heard what sounded like the sick man's groan,

units.source_text: 放心不下，半夜起身到父亲枕边去看了看。

en.t: and, unable to feel at ease, I got up in the middle of the night and went to Father's pillow to check on him.

units.source_text: 那天轮到母亲值夜班，她趴在父亲身旁，枕着胳膊睡着了。

en.t: That night it was Mother's turn to keep watch, and she had fallen asleep beside Father, lying forward with her head on her arm.

units.source_text: 父亲也像是在熟睡中被悄悄放在那里似的，静静地安睡着。

en.t: Father too lay quietly asleep, as though he had been gently placed there in deep slumber.

units.source_text: 我又蹑手蹑脚地回到了自己的铺上。

en.t: I tiptoed back to my own bedding.

units.source_text: 我和哥哥一起睡在一张蚊帐里。

en.t: My elder brother and I slept together inside the same mosquito net.

units.source_text: 只有妹夫，大概因为是客人吧，独自睡在客厅里。

en.t: Only my sister's husband, probably because he was a guest, slept alone in the parlor.

units.source_text: “关兄也真够受累的，拖了这么多天也回不去。”

en.t: Mr. Guan really has had a hard time too, being kept here so many days and unable to go home.

units.source_text: “不过，他也不是忙得不得了的人，应该可以多住些日子吧。

en.t: Still, he is not someone terribly busy, so he should be able to stay a few more days.

units.source_text: 比起关兄来，倒是哥哥更难办，这么长时间拖下去的话。”

en.t: Compared with Mr. Guan, it is actually Elder Brother who will have more trouble if this drags on so long.

units.source_text: “难办也没法子，这不是别的事。”

en.t: Even if it causes trouble, there is nothing to be done. This is not like other matters.
